ambiguities_and_limits: The six area pages are treated as the current active catalog because BCIT labels them as programs currently listed in its Program Catalogue.
The WordPress sitemap is broader and partly historical: 45 sitemap-only URLs redirect to current canonical entries, 20 return 404, and 14 remain live but are absent from every current area catalog.
Absence from all six current catalog pages supports 'not currently listed'; it does not independently prove BCIT's internal discontinued/inactive administrative status.
Program 5325ACERT remains a live page and an active Asteris record but is absent from all six current area catalogs. It is retained because cleanup was out of scope.
Statements of Completion and NOBCIT/non-credential pages are catalog listings but are excluded from the remaining importable program total.
All 217 current unloaded pages returned successfully during inspection; all 165 import candidates exposed identifiable BCIT course references in the published program matrix.

recommendation.scope: Import 50 of the 165 current credential-bearing candidates, distributed across credentials and schools. Exclude all 32 apprenticeship pages, all 20 special/non-program entries, and both prior holdbacks.
recommendation.preflight: Refresh each selected page immediately before audit/contract generation and retain exact program-ID, credential, canonical-URL, and course-reference checks.
